scientific_integrity: Underlying model and full cluster-size transition mechanism are credited to Gu and Yuan. The independent checker is finite arithmetic support, not a substitute for the general proof; historical uniqueness and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli site retention on a uniform random recursive tree only; an exact mixed covariance and fixed-parameter asymptotic, not a joint CLT, all-size sign classification, or fixed-deletion result. Priority assessment cannot exclude an earlier equivalent derivation of the known transition kernel.
title: Exact component–singleton covariance in site-percolated recursive trees
